name: S12-presence-to-the-room

name: S13-seen-stamped-on-first-tab
old: let next = gone ? { ...rec, seen: now } : rec;
new: let next = { ...rec, seen: now };
why: AUDIT QS6 F7: unobservable, and shown so rather than assumed. `next` is written to the store only under `if (gone)`, where the two agree; and a friend's presence row never reads `rec.seen` while the account is online (`_rowOf`: `seen: socks.length ? now : rec.seen`), so a `seen` stamped on a record that is not stored reaches nobody. The LAW - stamped when the last tab goes and not before - is pinned on the STORE in test/net/soc1_hub.test.js, which is where it is enforced.
